description: This file defines the EnforcePasswordDao class, which provides data access methods related to enforcing password policies, such as saving password requests, retrieving log entries by reset code, and updating request status in the database.

classes.name: EnforcePasswordDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for handling enforcement password request data operations.

methods.name: saveEnforcedPasswordRequest
methods.description: Persists an EnforcePasswordRequest entity to the database and returns the same entity.

methods.name: getEnforcedPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves an EnforcePasswordRequest entity matching the provided reset code if it exists.

methods.name: updateEnforcedPasswordValid
methods.description: Updates the 'expired' status of a password enforcement request for a specified user and returns true if the update affected any rows.
